changelog: **Executive dashboard in MARKETING (#3706):** a vertical without `mentorship` no longer sees the skills-growth Capability block or the programme-cohort selector on `/admin/analytics/executive`; the capability is resolved on the server (`page.tsx` is now a server parent of `ExecutiveDashboard`). MARKETING overlay copy (EN/TR/DE) names the third score "Won deals", the forecast "Wins by the horizon" and the subtitle three scores. Metrics unchanged; INTERNSHIP unchanged.

en: The executive dashboard in a marketing workspace speaks sales: "Won deals" and "Wins by the horizon", without the internship-only skills block and cohort filter.
tr: Marketing çalışma alanındaki yönetici panosu artık satış dilinde: "Kazanılan anlaşmalar" ve "Ufka kadar kazanımlar"; staja özgü beceri bloğu ve kohort filtresi yok.
de: Das Executive-Dashboard in einem Marketing-Arbeitsbereich spricht jetzt Vertrieb: „Gewonnene Deals“ und „Abschlüsse bis zum Horizont“, ohne den praktikumsspezifischen Kompetenzblock und den Kohortenfilter.
